_comment: Canonical animation state definitions, mini variant. body is a list of frame indices to cycle through (single-element = static pose). eyes/mouth are null where face positioning hasn't been figured out yet for that body orientation — sit_forward/sit_left/sit_back are new body poses whose face placement is a later task, not yet safe to assume matches the default forward-facing idle position. walk_right is derived from walk_left by horizontal mirroring (CSS scaleX(-1) or equivalent), not a separate sprite — see TamaAssembler's Mirror toggle to preview it.
